Counsel for Applicant :- Jai Prakash Singh,Raj Kiran Chaudhary Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Mrs. Manju Rani Chauhan,J.
Heard learned counsel for the applicant, Mr. K.P. Pathak, learned AGA for the State and perused the record.

This application under Section 482 Cr.P.C. has been filed by the applicant to quash the charge sheet dated 17.07.2020 submitted in Case Crime No. 228 of 2020, under section 188, 269, 270 IPC Section 31(1)63 Food Safety and Standards Authority, 2006 and 3 The Epidemic Diseases Act, 1897,
P.S. Mugalsarai, District Chandauli as well as cognizance dated 21.08.2020 passed by Chief Judicial Magistrate, Chandauli in the present case.
At the very outset

, learned counsel for the applicant gave up his challenge to the aforesaid prayer and confined his submission requesting to grant some protection to the applicant to surrender before the concerned court below.

The learned counsel for the applicant further stated at the Bar that he is not pressing any other prayer made in this application on merits and prayed that a Nizamuddin vs State Of U.P.And Another on 28 February, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/83956724/
1 direction may be issued to the concerned courts below to consider and decide the bail application/surrender application of the applicants expeditiously.

entities.text: Nizamuddin vs State Of U.P.And Another on 28 February, 2023 Indian Kanoon
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Learned A.G.A. for the State of U.P. submits that in case the applicant is not pressing the relief as sought for by them on merits and want to surrender before the concerned court below, he has no objection in granting protection to them for a short period.

In view of above, considering the aforesaid alternative prayer made by learned counsel for the applicant, it is directed that the applicants shall file a surrender application before the concerned court below on or before 16th March, 2023.

On receiving the surrender application, the court concerned shall obtain instructions from the public prosecutor and fix a date for appearance/surrender of the applicant(s) and for hearing the applicant(s) on surrender application.
On the date fixed by the Court concerned, the applicant(s) will have liberty to prefer a bail application and a copy of the same be provided to the public prosecutor.

In case, any such bail application is filed, the same shall be considered by the court below along with the surrender application, on the date fixed, in accordance with law and keeping in view the guidelines as laid down by the Apex Court in the case of Satender Kumar Antil vs. Central Bureau of Investigation and another, reported in (2021) 10 SCC 773.

entities.text: Satender Kumar Antil vs. Central Bureau of Investigation and another, reported in (2021) 10 SCC 773
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: For the period of 20 days from today or till the surrender application is decided, whichever is earlier, no coercive action shall be taken against the applicant.
In case the applicant(s) does not comply with the aforesaid directions, the court below shall be free to take such measures for appearance of the applicant(s) as required under the law.
With the above observations and directions, this application under Section 482 Cr.P.C. is disposed of.
